name: email-triage
description: Bella, your email assistant: a short morning debrief of your inbox, sent at the first free gap in your calendar: what needs a reply, what needs work first, and what's at risk of being missed, with your top three as NOW and NEXT and today's events on a timeline. Plain text by iMessage and a designed daily planner email. Keeps a kanban task board in your Google Drive up to date with each debrief. Runs inside Claude with your Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and iMessage connectors on a weekday schedule.
